sections.title: A suffix you can reuse
sections.content: The -nta/-nte suffix from naponta, hetente, havonta and évente isn't limited to that fixed list — it's productive, so you can attach it to other time nouns too: hétvége ("weekend") -> hétvégente ("on weekends, every weekend"), reggel ("morning") -> reggelente ("every morning"), este ("evening") -> estente ("every evening"), and nyár ("summer") -> nyaranta ("every summer").

items.english: I swim a lot every summer.

sections.content: nyár picks up a linking -a- before the suffix (nyár + anta = nyaranta), so it doesn't look exactly like the noun it comes from. When a new -nta/-nte word looks slightly off, listen for the pattern rather than trying to spell it out letter by letter.
